story_text.value: Do you buy into the hype around AI and AI agents? I work in private equity and venture capital, and we recently had an internal discussion about whether AI could eventually replace analysts and deal sourcing employees for investment screening and due diligence. It would obviously save firms a ton of money and time, but there's concern about the accuracy. What’s your take?
